title: Moon ruins at 33° in the Disney-von Braun film

tellings.quote: In one extended scene, a team of astronauts travel to the far side of the moon for the first time. That's when a radar engineer yells out that some kind of radiation is being picked up on their sensors at 33°.

plain: In one of the 1950s space exploration films that Walt Disney's studio made with the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun, astronauts reach the far side of the Moon for the first time, and a radar engineer shouts that some kind of radiation is being picked up at 33°. Michels tells this himself, describing the scene as a find of ruins on the Moon, and reads the number 33 as a hidden symbol slipped into the film.
